---
title: "01 · Foundations and baselines"
---

What changes when a model can observe the consequences of its own actions?

## Concepts

Describe an agent as a controller that chooses an action from the current state, receives an observation, and either updates state or stops. Identify where control lives in a fixed workflow and in a model-directed loop [@anthropic2024effectiveagents; @yao2023react].

## Study task

For the [AutoResearch case](../case-studies/autoresearch.qmd), draw one-shot prediction, fixed candidate search, and adaptive candidate search. Mark who chooses the next action and where the run terminates.

## Deliverable

Produce three diagrams and a table comparing decision authority, termination, and one measurable benefit of added autonomy.
